n = int(input())
b = int(input())
a = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]

oddCount = [0] * (n + 1)
evenCount = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if a[i - 1] & 1 == 1:
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1] + 1
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1]
    else:
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1]
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1] + 1

startIdx = 0
import heapq
diffHeap = []

for i in range(1, n):
    oDiff = oddCount[i] - oddCount[startIdx]
    eDiff = evenCount[i] - evenCount[startIdx]
    if oDiff == eDiff:
        heapq.heappush(diffHeap, abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]))
        startIdx = i

totalCost = 0
selectedCount = 0
while diffHeap and totalCost + diffHeap[0] <= b:
    totalCost += heapq.heappop(diffHeap)
    selectedCount += 1

print(selectedCount)
